column4: Includes first and subsequent withdrawals.  1995 increase was due to withdrawals of government cash grant under Share Ownership Top-up Scheme II and CPF top-up scheme.  2000 & 2001 increase was due to withdrawals of government CPF top-up scheme.  2003 & 2004 increase was due to withdrawals of the economic restructuring shares and relaxation of withdrawal rule from once in 3 years to annually.  2005 & 2006 increase was due to withdrawals of government top-ups & sale proceeds from their Singtel shares.
